verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit and MCP server document `create_product` for catalog products and subscription plan creation, which can carry pricing. Invoices or orders can be created and shared via a secure URL in the same agent session. However, the only Payment Link evidence describes a no-code dashboard feature, not an API, so the agent needs adjacent primitives to approximate the flow. Missing for 10: a documented API or agent tool for Payment Links, a standalone price object for one-time products, and hands-on corroboration of a single-session product→price→link flow.
